Get RPS rule coding from the package or a URL

Source: R/rps_rules.R
fetch_rps.Rd

Without arguments, returns the bundled coding (same as rps_rules()). With URLs, downloads CSV files that follow the rps_rules() layout, for example a shared or corrected version of the coding, and caches them. The package does not redistribute DSIRE, LBNL or PUDL data; if you build your own coding from those sources, check their terms of use.

Usage

fetch_rps(rules_url = NULL, targets_url = NULL, cache = TRUE, refresh = FALSE)

Arguments

rules_url, targets_url

URLs (or local paths) of CSV files.

cache

Use the local download cache.

refresh

Ignore any cached copy and download again.

Value

An rps_rules object.

Examples

fetch_rps()
